name: Loop of 2 hours west of Sjöbo, not through Malmö's outskirts
description: From a real test (2026-09-26): heading west, the best loop rode about 16 km along Malmö's outskirts (Bunkeflo, Husie, Kvarnby) on 50–80 km/h roads past suburbs. A city's outskirts are no fun even at country-road speeds; a town or village on the way is fine. Roads in large built-up areas now cost more and count as not curvy, and loop waypoints keep out of them.
